claims.text: Cauchy introduced the general method for resolving systems of simultaneous equations on 18 October 1847, in a note in the Comptes Rendus, and Hadamard later gave the procedure the name method of descent.

source.title: Cauchy, A. L., Méthode générale pour la résolution des systèmes d’équations simultanées, Comptes Rendus de l’Académie des Sciences, Paris, 25:536-538, 1847

claims.text: The attribution is layered: steepest descent is traced to Cauchy in 1829 for solving a nonlinear equation connected to approximating an integral, Curry published on the method for non-linear minimization problems in 1944, and Kantorovich introduced the form used today in 1945.

source.title: Cauchy, A. L., Méthode générale pour la résolution des systèmes d’équations simultanées, Comptes Rendus de l’Académie des Sciences, Paris, 25:536-538, 1847

beats.broke: you need to know which way to move to improve something, and the function relating the two is complicated everywhere and only needs to be understood nearby
beats.fix: replace the function near a point with the straight line that best matches it there, which is a single number and is enough to say which way is down
beats.cost: the line only resembles the function near the point, so any use of it is valid only within a distance the derivative itself does not tell you
beats.interview: why a step size exists at all, given that the derivative already tells you which way to go
